title: Snapkey
subtitle: Assign a key or key combination to each screenshot action. Changes apply immediately.
conflictBody: %1 is already used by “%2”. Replace that binding?
conflictSnapkey: %1 is already assigned to %2 in Snapkey.
unsupportedKey: That key cannot be bound. Try a letter, digit, F-key, or Print.
modifierRequired: Add Super, Ctrl, Alt, or Shift, or use Print or an F-key.
helperError: Snapkey could not read the current bindings.
bindingError: Snapkey could not save that key.
hints: ↑↓ move · Enter assign · Del reset · ? help · Esc close
help.title: Keyboard
help.body:
↑ / ↓ or J / K	Move between actions
Enter or Space	Assign a key
Delete or Backspace	Reset the action to Omarchy's default
?	Show this help
Esc or Q	Close Snapkey

Snapkey writes your choices into a managed block at the end of ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua, then reloads Hyprland and rolls back if the new config has errors. The rest of the file is left untouched.
